assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual architectural illustration for an elegant opera website. Subject: Metropolitan Opera House at Lincoln Center, New York, recognizable five tall arched glass entrances and broad travertine facade. Primary request: a sensitive freehand graphite pencil sketch drawn by a skilled painter in a travel sketchbook, not a diagram or vector icon. Three-quarter near-frontal view with believable architectural detail and slight perspective. Expressive exploratory contour lines, broken edges, natural variation in pencil pressure, delicate irregular crosshatching, rich graphite in recessed windows, soft rubbed graphite shadows, sparse unfinished construction marks. Fine-art observational drawing, restrained and sophisticated, monochrome black and gray pencil only. Building fully visible centered with generous empty margins, wide landscape 3:2 composition. Pure white background fading to clean white around the drawing, no paper border. No people, text, labels, signature, watermark, colored washes, solid black silhouette, perfectly straight CAD lines, uniform repeated hatching or graphic icon styling. Render one building only.
